title: WPSS/332/2024 of SHESHNATH RAI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No.332 of 2024
Sheshnath Rai ........Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others .....Respondents
Presence:-
Mr. Anand Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Ramesh Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J. (Oral)

Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner has challenged the order dated
13.02.2024, passed by respondent no.2, annexure-9 to
the writ petition, whereby petitioner was denied the
appointment on compassionate ground on the post of
Nursery Development Officer in the respondent-department.
3. It is the case of the petitioner that petitioner
has applied for compassionate appointment pursuant to
unfortunate demise of his father, who died on 28.04.2021,
while still in service. Petitioner was offered appointment
by respondent-department vide appointment letter dated
21.04.2023. Subsequently, petitioner was denied the
joining on the ground that there was no verification of his
qualification of graduation and post graduation.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that
vide letter dated 10.03.2023, which was addressed by
University to the Director of the respondent-department,
the qualification of the petitioner has been verified and
despite that he was not being given joining pursuant to
the appointment letter dated 21.04.2023.

2
5. Vide order dated 04.03.2024, learned State
Counsel was directed to get clear instructions as to why
the petitioner was required to appear in the typing test
when he was already given appointment on the post of
Nursery Development Officer.
6. Today, learned State Counsel passed on the
written instructions, which are taken on record.
7. Since the written instructions have been filed
by the State in the writ petition, therefore, the writ
petition is being decided with the consent of the learned
counsel for the parties.
8. In the written instructions, it has been stated
that the petitioner was appointed on a Supernumerary
post of Supervisor with the respondent-department. But,
on the pointed query of the Court as to why petitioner
was asked to appear in a typing test when he has already
been appointed, it is stated by learned State Counsel that
on the basis of the instructions that petitioner was given
appointment on the post of Junior Assistant (a post
which has been created as Supernumerary for the
purpose of accommodating petitioner on compassionate
ground) and the proceeding to cancel the earlier
appointment dated 21.04.2023 is in progress.
9. From the appointment letter dated 21.04.2023,
annexure-1 to the writ petition, it is reflected that
petitioner was given appointment on the post of
Supervisor pay scale 25500-81100 (Pay Level-4).
10. It is admitted by the learned State Counsel
that for the post of Supervisor, the typing test is not one

3
of the qualification, rather, B.Sc. is the necessary
qualification.
11. Since petitioner is having the qualification of
M.Sc. (AG) from Manad University Hapur, Uttar Pradesh
and the document of its verification has already been filed
by the petitioner on record, the appointment of the
petitioner cannot be changed in this manner and he
cannot be asked after issuance of the appointment to
appear in a typing test and to accept a post of which he
has never been appointed.
12. In this view of the matter, the writ petition is
allowed. The order dated 13.02.2024, passed by
respondent no.2 is hereby quashed. A mandamus is
issued to the respondents to immediately give joining to
the petitioner on the post of Supervisor pay scale 25500-
81100 (Pay Level-4) within ten days from the date of
production of certified copy of this order. No order as to
costs.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 02.05.2024
AK
